messages:
Sam: Observed a billing delta tied to short-lived retries after client backpressure. Console shows lower token count than ledger for certain streams.
Priya: Can you share a trace and a quick summary of what happened?
Sam: trace=bdg-900, shard=us-west-2, router=stable. TL;DR: client sent partial chunk, server applied backpressure, client retried with different idempotency key; ledger shows both provisional and confirmed entries.
Sam: logs excerpt:
Sam: ```
[2026-07-10T16:10:01Z] session=bdg-900 recv chunk offset=0 size=512 partial=true
[2026-07-10T16:10:02Z] router emitted provisional_meter tag=pm-451 session=bdg-900
[2026-07-10T16:10:03Z] client retry start idempotency=none
[2026-07-10T16:10:04Z] toolcall confirm tc=tc-451 ledger_tag=lt-900 confirmed=true
[2026-07-10T16:10:04Z] stream ack offset=0 ledger_tag=lt-900
[2026-07-10T16:10:04Z] stream ack offset=0 ledger_tag=pm-451 provisional
```
Jules: So provisional tag exists and later a confirmed tag arrives; reconciliation should collapse to confirmed but UI currently de-duplicates by latest tag and hides provisional-but-earlier tokens causing console undercount.
Priya: SQL to find similar sessions: 
Priya: ```sql
SELECT session_id, count(*) as dup_count
FROM stream_acks
WHERE provisional = true
AND exists (SELECT 1 FROM stream_acks s2 WHERE s2.session_id = stream_acks.session_id AND s2.offset = stream_acks.offset AND s2.provisional = false AND abs(extract(epoch from (s2.ts - stream_acks.ts))) < 2)
GROUP BY session_id HAVING count(*)>0;
```
ops-bot: Alert triggered: "metering_provisional_shadowing" rate 0.6% > 0.2%. Incident INC-8042 created.
metering-bot: Runbook step: mark provisional tags as "transient" and prefer confirmed when both exist within 2s window.
Sam: Quick mitigations proposed: 1) console change to count both provisional and confirmed separately (show provisional as pending); 2) reconciliation job: collapse provisional to confirmed if confirmed arrives within window; 3) router change: avoid emitting provisional tag when retry idempotency absent.
Jules: Implementation notes: console fix is quick. Reconciliation job requires caution (already reconciles by session+offset, but needs to consider provisional flag and timestamp order).
Priya: Router/patch idea: only emit provisional_meter when an idempotency key or client-session header present. Pseudocode: 
Priya: ```go
if req.Header.Get("X-Idempotency") == "" && req.Header.Get("X-Client-Session") == "" {
 // don't pre-emit provisional meter tag
} else {
 tag := allocateProvisionalTag()
 req.Header.Set("X-Provisional-Meter", tag)
}
```
Sam: I'll open console PR for pending token display and an alert panel "provisional_vs_confirmed_ratio" at 0.25%. Jules, can you own reconciliation change? Priya please own router tweak.
Jules: Will add a dry-run mode to reconciliation so we can measure impact before mutating ledger rows.
ops-bot: Timeline: console PR -> canary today; router tweak + reconciliation dry-run tomorrow; full reconciliation if dry-run <0.1% false positives.
Priya: Also need tests for proxy header-strip case (proxies sometimes drop X-Client-Session). Add proxy whitelist to preserve idempotency headers.
Sam: Thanks — keeping thread for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
